Common issues:

• Upload error - Wait 2-3 minutes, retry
• File not supported - Ensure .csv format, not .xlsx
• Missing fields - Check headers: Date,Weight,BMI,Fat
• Invalid format - Use YYYY-MM-DD dates, '.' decimals

⚠ Never open CSV files in Excel!

For detailed troubleshooting, tap Troubleshooting Guide below.
